comments: The code does not store a true optical pulse duration. It only uses an effective waveform width for the simulated source pulse.
The workflow simulates one excitation event per sample, not a repeated pulse train.
The code does not include separate mu_a, fluence F, or Gruneisen parameter Gamma. It uses a direct effective acoustic source instead.
This is the main source-control parameter currently present in the code. It acts as an effective acoustic center frequency, not a full laser-side model.
This controls where the simulated source pulse is centered inside the total time window.
